why: A ⇒ B: 'fderiv = 0 ⟺ all partials vanish' is linear algebra on the coordinate basis. For the second clause, the blind nested-partials matrix hmat equals the matrix of Morse.hessian = fderiv (fderiv f) (fderiv_clm_apply). Then isNondegenerate_hessian_iff_det_ne_zero and isNondegenerate_iff_nullity_eq_zero from A finish, together with the identity v ⬝ (H w) = H(v,w), which shows that B's nul is the project's nullity. B ⇒ A fails: A holds for an arbitrary normed space E (hessian_symm, index_isGreatest, and the nullity criterion for any finite-dimensional E), while B speaks only of ℝⁿ = Fin n → ℝ. B also makes no claim about the index (index_isGreatest has no counterpart).
B_issue: B defines idx (Milnor's index) but asserts nothing about it, so the index part of Milnor's text is not formalized in B.
